Name: Decorative Bushes - DGA and AT
Author: rxguesend
Description:
[center]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/8mMq9IJ.png[/img][/center][list]
[*]Adds five new furniture items: Berry Bush, Medium Bush, Big Bush, Small Bush, and Island Bush.
[*]All bushes are seasonal or have seasonal alternative textures.
[*]The berry bush will sprout berries during the usual berry seasons in Spring and Fall.
[*]Config setting to enable or disable the bushes being sold in shops ([i]default: true[/i]).
[/list][list]
[*][b]Optional: [/b]An all-in-one AT pack containing some alternative vanilla textures for the five bushes - such as sprouting berry bushes ([i]have berries all season long![/i]), an alternative summer variant of the berry bush, alternative variants of the small bush, alternative island bushes, and town exclusive bushes, as well as retextures of all bushes from other popular mods.
[/list]
[u][center]﻿[u][img]https://i.imgur.com/KTxbOMl.png[/img]﻿[/u][/center][/u][list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365]Dynamic Game Assets[/url]﻿ and all requirements.
[*]([i]If getting the optional all-in-one AT pack, also install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿ and all requirements. The folder structure was set up in a way where you can simply delete the folder of any pack you don't want, allowing for picking and choosing only the packs you want. [b]The AT pack requires the DGA pack to function[/b][/i]).
[*]Download and unzip this mod into \Stardew Valley\Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[center]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/8kSvo6B.png[/img]﻿[/center][list]
[*]You can purchase the new bushes at Robin's shop and the Island Trader. If you disabled that option, they can be spawned in with the following console command: [b]dga_store[/b].
[*]If you got the optional all-in-one AT pack, you can pick between the alternative textures by purchasing the Paint Bucket from Robin and using it on any of the new bushes.
[/list]
[center]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ot2vfih.png[/img]﻿[/center][list]
[*]The authors of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365]Dynamic Game Assets[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿ for making this mod possible.
[*]ConcernedApe, and the authors of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8164]Simple Foliage[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4966]Foliage Redone[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Earthy Recolor[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1869]Starblue Valley[/url]﻿ for the assets.
[*]The modders of the Stardew Valley Discord for helping me out when I needed it.

[/list]
